fields.learningPoint: People reached and moved within the islands at different times. The population history is complex, not one journey by one group. Contact could involve movement, exchange and learning among people already present and newcomers.

answerExplanations.A: The first note has a limited scope; it does not show that every community or period followed the same pattern.
answerExplanations.B: A point about Language Connections does not cancel a separate point about Many Journeys Over Time.
answerExplanations.C: The notes describe separate findings. They do not state that one caused the other.
answerExplanations.D: Each note supports a focused point about its topic. The notes do not establish one pattern for all communities.

fields.optionA: The first note proves that every community followed the same practice described for Many Journeys Over Time.
fields.optionB: The second note about Language Connections disproves the first; both points cannot describe community life.
fields.optionC: The note about Many Journeys Over Time caused the point about Language Connections everywhere, though neither note states that link.
fields.optionD: The first note supports its point about Many Journeys Over Time; the second supports its point about Language Connections. Neither proves one rule for every community.

fields.question: A class compares two notes: Language Connections: "Austronesian is a language family that includes many Philippine languages." fields.learningPoint: Austronesian is a language family that includes many Philippine languages. It is not the name of one single culture or one fixed biological race.
